title: HoloMap Navigation Manual
summary: Turn scanned terrain, markers, waypoints, overlays, and routes into better travel decisions.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: HoloMap is a planning surface. Its value is not the map image alone, but how markers, overlays, routes, and discovered tiles change what you choose to do next.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Open the map near base, mark storage and exits, and place only the waypoint types you will actually use. Too many marks can hide urgent ones.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Scan terrain, mark a route, add hazard or objective notes, travel, then prune or update the map after the run.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Terrain tiles, waypoints, marker states, overlays, and route records all contribute to the same navigation layer.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: WorldCore feeds region context, Convoy benefits from route clarity, Recovery marks return paths, and Lens or Wiki can explain what a marker represents.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If the map becomes noisy, delete stale markers, rename important waypoints, and separate danger marks from storage or mission marks.
